articles.summary: The Generation Essentials Group (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE) ("TGE" or the "Company"), today announced that it will hold an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders (the "EGM") at 9:00 a.m. (Eastern Standard Time) on December 7, 2026. The EGM will be held as a hybrid meeting with a physical meeting located at 66 Rue Jean-Jacques Rousseau, 75001 Paris, France and virtual attendance and participation by members and/or proxies via the internet at https://www.cstproxy.com/thegenerationessentials/2026 . A proposal to consolidate the Company's shares will be submitted to the Company's shareholders to be considered and voted upon at the EGM. If the proposal is approved by an ordinary resolution of the shareholders, (a) every fifteen (15) issued and unissued voting Class A ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.0000000264856557377049 each in the share capital of the Company will be consolidated into one (1) voting Class A ordinary share of a par value of US$0.0000003972848360655735 each, (b)
articles.title: The Generation Essentials Group to Hold Extraordinary General Meeting on December 7, 2026

articles.summary: AMTD IDEA Group (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB), a NYSE and SGX-ST dual-listed company and a subsidiary of AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (NYSE: HKD), a controlled and consolidated subsidiary of AMTD IDEA Group, and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), a controlled and consolidated subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly announced today the injection of four premium hotel assets into TGE. articles.title: AMTD IDEA, AMTD Digital and TGE Jointly Announce the Injection of Four Premium Hotel Assets into TGE
